# CPython native component notices

These unmodified notice files are extracted from the upstream python-build-standalone 20261110 CPython 3.12.16 aarch64-apple-darwin pgo+lto full archive. `components.json` records the archive digest, matching install-only interpreter digest, and upstream extension license mappings.

Source: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/tag/20261110

The build copies this directory into the bundled Python runtime under `PRODUCK-LICENSES`. Upstream license identifiers are recorded as supplied; existing Python and pip notices remain in their original runtime locations. No original third-party PRD skill scripts are redistributed.
